Messages.Author: Robert Ekvall
Messages.Body:
If a vamp with cap 3 is given a skill card and later burned, how much
pool is gained by playing "reclaiming the lost soul"?

Also if a vampire increases his/her capacity by one through the use of a
praxis seizure (corresponding with his/her clan) and that title is
subsequently contested how does this affect his/her capacity? Is there a
difference between contesting and being forced to give up the title?

Are skillcards, equipment and similar left on a vampire that had them,
was burned and "revived" with possesion?

Thanx,

Robert

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
Robert Ekvall wrote:
>
> If a vamp with cap 3 is given a skill card and later burned, how much
> pool is gained by playing "reclaiming the lost soul"?

1 (3/2, round down). The skill card doesn't stay "on" a burned vampire.
All cards "on" a burned card are burned as well.

> Also if a vampire increases his/her capacity by one through the use of a
> praxis seizure (corresponding with his/her clan) and that title is
> subsequently contested how does this affect his/her capacity? Is there a
> difference between contesting and being forced to give up the title?

Title-based capacity applies only while the title is held. If the
title is contested or yielded or lost through other means, the capacity
bonus is lost as well. [TOM 10-FEB-1996]

> Are skillcards, equipment and similar left on a vampire that had them,
> was burned and "revived" with possesion?

No. Cards on a burned card are burned.
